```sql
SELECT a.abbreviation, a.country
FROM airlines a
JOIN flights f ON a.id = f.airline_id
GROUP BY a.id, a.abbreviation, a.country
HAVING COUNT(f.id) = (
    SELECT MIN(flight_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(id) AS flight_count
        FROM flights
        GROUP BY airline_id
    ) AS counts
);
```
